rationale: Independent re-verification of wp-5624-01 against report 5624: 36/43 checks pass, 6 fail, 1 not run. Source hash, all 4 section digests, every locator and the registered count contradiction reproduce. Findings: F-03(minor); F-04(minor); F-02(minor); F-01(major); F-06(informational); F-05(minor). Nothing is marked verified by this review.

findings.finding: F-03 locator_check reports 9/9 resolved, but two of the nine items (5624-ref-01 and 5624-ref-02) quote the same sentence, so distinct locator evidence is 8, not 9. Resolution is real for every item.

F-04 content_digests[1].occurrences is declared 1, but its 16-hex raw text is also a substring of the full 64-hex digest on line 25, so it occurs twice in the source. The declared prefix_of/prefix_consistent relation is correct.

F-02 observations[0] presents 'three count calibers' in conflict, but the third one (116 index entries, line 29) is the arithmetic closure 102 + 14 mission artefacts, i.e. not a conflicting count; and its locator other_file_count_lines points at line 43, which states a sample size (20 files), not an inventory count. The observation is substantiated for the 0-vs-102 pair, overstated otherwise, and its third locator is mis-attributed.

F-01 The report body states 0 files for each of the two artefact roots (line 7) and then 102 files / 6.45 MB for the same two roots (line 8), while the Fig.1 caption gives the split 94 + 8 = 102. Two of the three statements cannot both be true. The manifest registered this as unresolved observation 5624-obs-01 instead of choosing a number, which is the correct 01 behaviour, so the registration passes and only downstream inventory claims are blocked.

F-06 The package ships fig_acceptance.png while the record registers fig1_inventory/fig2_sizes/fig3_acceptance with no per-image digest, so the shipped PNG cannot be bound to any registered figure name or content.

F-05 boundary carries a field literally named verification_status (value 'none — 由平台门独立计算，本包不标 verified'). No verification is asserted, but the field name is exactly the one GATE-RULES S9 forbids in 03/04 products, so the envelope cannot be promoted into a 03 package unchanged.
